title: Le verbe 'to be'
ruleEN: Used to describe a person, thing, or state.
ruleFR: Utilisé pour décrire une personne, chose, ou état.
examples: I am a student. (Je suis un étudiant.)
She is happy. (Elle est heureuse.)
They are from London. (Ils sont de Londres.)

title: Present Simple
ruleFR: Utilisé pour les habitudes, vérités générales.
examples: I wake up at 7 AM. (Je me réveille à 7h.)
Water boils at 100 degrees. (L'eau bout à 100°.)
He plays football on Sundays. (Il joue au foot le dimanche.)

title: Present Continuous
ruleFR: Utilisé pour les actions en cours en ce moment.
examples: I am studying now. (J'étudie en ce moment.)
They are staying in a hotel. (Ils logent à l'hôtel.)
Is it raining? (Pleut-il ?)

title: Past Simple
ruleFR: Utilisé pour des actions terminées dans le passé.
examples: I watched a movie yesterday. (J'ai regardé un film hier.)
She went to Paris last year. (Elle est allée à Paris l'an dernier.)
Did you finish? (As-tu fini ?)

title: Present Perfect
ruleFR: Connecte le passé au présent.
examples: I have visited Paris. (J'ai visité Paris.)
She has finished her homework. (Elle a fini ses devoirs.)
Have you ever eaten sushi? (As-tu déjà mangé des sushis ?)

title: Past Continuous
ruleFR: Action passée en cours.
examples: I was watching TV when the phone rang. (Je regardais la télé quand...)
They were playing tennis. (Ils jouaient au tennis.)
While she was reading, he was sleeping. (Pendant qu'elle lisait...)

title: First Conditional
ruleFR: Situation réelle ou très probable dans le futur.
examples: If it rains, we will stay at home. (S'il pleut, on restera.)
I will call you if I have time. (Je t'appellerai si j'ai le temps.)
If she studies, she will pass. (Si elle étudie, elle réussira.)

title: Second Conditional
ruleFR: Situation improbable ou hypothétique.
examples: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house. (Si je gagnais...)
If I were you, I would tell the truth. (Si j'étais toi...)
She would travel more if she had money. (Elle voyagerait plus...)

title: Third Conditional
ruleFR: Condition passée impossible et son résultat.
examples: If I had studied, I would have passed. (Si j'avais étudié...)
We wouldn't have been late if we had taken a taxi. (Nous ne serions pas...)
If she had known, she would have come. (Si elle avait su...)

title: Inversion
ruleFR: Inversion après un adverbe négatif.
examples: Never have I seen such a sunset. (Jamais je n'ai vu...)
Hardly had he arrived when the meeting started. (À peine était-il...)
Under no circumstances should you open this door. (En aucun cas...)
